title: Parse: Extract requirements from RD Lookup
description:
Parse: RD Lookup (RFC 9176 §6, spec §10.6)

MUST/SHALL/SHOULD/MAY extracted from RFC 9176:

**MUST (Blocking for compliance):**
- MUST support query filtering for the rt parameter (RFC 6690 style) [§4.3.5, §6.2]
- MUST support matching with multiple search criteria (AND logic - all must match) [§6.2.3]
- MUST NOT show links with link-local base URIs unless lookup is from same link [§6.1.4]
- MUST NOT include zone identifiers in resolved URIs [§6.1.3]
- MUST support application/link-format content format [§4.2]
- MUST resolve target references fully (base + href) [§6.1.1]

**SHOULD:**
- SHOULD present links in path-absolute form [§6.4.3]

**MAY (Optional enhancements):**
- MAY support pagination via page and count parameters [§6.2]
- MAY support additional content formats beyond link-format [§4.2]
- MAY replace registration base URIs with configured intermediate proxy [§6.1.1]

**Response codes:**
- 2.05 Content with application/link-format (or CBOR variant) payload [§6.2]
- Empty payload if no matches (still 2.05)

**Query parameters:**
- rt: resource type filter (MUST support)
- ep: endpoint name filter
- d: sector/domain filter
- page: pagination page number (0-indexed)
- count: results per page

**Test vectors:** See test/vectors/coap_rd.json (rd_lookup_res_by_rt)

Ambiguities: LICHEN uses CBOR (Content-Format 60) rather than link-format; verify CBOR encoding matches semantics. Link-local filtering may not apply if all addresses are Yggdrasil 0200::/8.
close_reason: Parse complete - checklist extracted from RFC 9176 §4.2-4.3, §6.1-6.4. 6 MUST, 1 SHOULD, 3 MAY requirements identified for /rd-lookup/res endpoint.
